meta.title: Services — Automation God
meta.description: AI-powered automation services for SMBs. Workflow automation, lead generation, data pipelines, AI support, and process consulting.

hero.label: What We Do
hero.headline: We Build Systems That Work While You Sleep.
hero.subheadline: Every service we offer is designed around one goal: eliminate the manual work that's slowing your business down and replace it with intelligent automation.

services.title: AI Workflow Automation
services.tagline: Replace repetitive tasks with intelligent, self-running systems.
services.description: We map your existing processes, identify every manual touchpoint, and replace them with AI-driven workflows that run 24/7 without human intervention. From document processing to multi-step approvals, we automate the full chain.

services.title: Lead Generation Systems
services.description: We build end-to-end lead generation machines: automated prospecting, AI-powered qualification, personalized outreach sequences, and CRM sync. Your sales team only talks to leads that are ready to buy.

services.title: Data Pipeline Automation
services.tagline: Connect your tools. Eliminate manual data entry forever.
services.description: We build real-time data pipelines that connect your entire tech stack — CRM, ERP, marketing tools, databases, and more. Data flows automatically, stays clean, and is always where it needs to be.
services.outcome: 89% average reduction in manual data entry

services.title: AI Customer Support
services.tagline: Handle 80% of support tickets without a human.
services.description: We train AI on your knowledge base, products, and policies to handle the majority of customer inquiries automatically. Complex issues escalate to your team with full context — so they can resolve faster.
useCases: AI chatbot trained on your knowledge base

services.title: Process Consulting
services.tagline: Map, audit, and redesign your workflows for maximum efficiency.
services.description: Before we automate anything, we make sure we're automating the right things. Our process consulting engagement maps your entire operation, identifies the highest-ROI automation opportunities, and delivers a prioritized roadmap.
services.outcome: Clients identify avg. $180K/yr in automation savings

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.headline: Transparent Pricing. Real ROI.
pricing.subheadline: Every engagement is scoped to your specific needs. These tiers give you a starting point.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.description: Perfect for businesses that want to test automation with a single high-impact workflow.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.tagline: Full automation stack for growing teams.
tiers.description: For businesses ready to automate multiple workflows and connect their entire tech stack.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.description: For organizations ready to automate at scale across departments and systems.

cta.headline: Not Sure Where to Start?
cta.subheadline: Book a free 30-minute discovery call. We'll identify your top automation opportunity and give you a clear ROI estimate — no commitment required.
